subject: baku
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: baku, the dream-eating tapir spirit.
Style: ukiyo-e woodblock print.

spec.name: Baku, the Dream-Eater
spec.description: A baku—the dream-eating tapir spirit—standing proudly in ukiyo-e woodblock style: a heavy indigo barrel body with a cream belly, a gold crescent on its brow, a short prehensile trunk curling dream-smoke, wave-pattern bands on its flank and stylized cloud swirls pooled at its feet.
spec.layout: The baku stands on y = 0 on four short columnar tapir legs, facing +Z. Front to back: a short muscular trunk curls down and slightly forward from the front of a high, round-skulled head (ears at the top, small alert eyes, gold crescent moon emblem on the brow, small bone tusks at the jaw corners, jaw built as separate upper and lower pieces); the neck rises steeply from a heavy barrel torso whose back peaks around y = 1.5 at the shoulders and slopes to the rump; a ridge of flat blade-like mane tufts runs along the spine from the neck base to the tail base; a short lion-like tail curls up behind the rump with a bold tuft. The whole silhouette is chunky and rounded like a tapir blended with a guardian lion-dog. Style on every part: flat bold colours only, every surface one flat colour, with ukiyo-e detail built as separate seated parts—ink outline strips along edges, pale-blue seigaiha wave bands across the lower flank, gold collar and anklet bands, ink claw and nostril marks, and glowing teal dream-smoke wisps (emissive) curling from the trunk tip and drifting above the back. Stylized flat cloud swirls in pale blue with ink rims pool on the floor around the feet. Proportions pushed for character: the trunk slightly long and expressive, the ears large and round, the mane tufts bold and spiky, the belly deep and cream-bright against the dark indigo back.

parts.builds: The barrel torso: a smooth-skinned sweep or loft along the spine from tailBase (z = -0.85) through root and chest to neckBase (z = 0.78, y = 1.42), heavy and deep—radius about 0.42 at the chest tapering to 0.34 at the rump, with the belly line pushed low (belly bottom near y = 0.75, back top near y = 1.5). Main coat indigo on the back and sides, cream underneath: colour the tube with a paint or sector split so the cream belly rises in a zig-zag fur edge across the flank (ukiyo-e style hard edge). On the lower flank add a seigaiha-style wave band: two or three thin overlapping crescent strips (extruded slabs or stuck thin curved pieces) in wave pale-blue with thin ink outline strips along their top edges, sweeping from shoulder to hip on both sides. Along the spine from neckBase to tailBase build the mane crest: 8-10 flat blade tufts (extrudes with sharp tips, thickness tapering to a knife edge) alternating ink, plum and gold, rooted on the back line and sweeping backward, tallest at the shoulders (about 0.22). Where the neck meets the body add a vermilion collar band: a swept band around the neck root with a thin gold trim ring on its front edge and small gold studs. Add subtle night-coloured shading strips along the underside seams where belly meets side. Everything joins through the root and chest joints; the body must not overlap the head box or the leg boxes—leave the shoulder and hip mounts as open sockets and place a small vermilion socket blush disc at each of the four limb mounts for the legs part to meet.
parts.attaches: Front face of the box meets the head part at mount neckBase; the mane crest's front tuft sits just behind neckBase under the head. Rear end stops at mount tailBase where the aura part's tail begins. Lower corners of the box sit just above the legs part's box, meeting it at the four limb mounts (shoulderFL/FR, hipHL/HR) with socket blushes.

parts.builds: The head on the head joint at [0, 1.75, 1.12], facing +Z with a slight upward tilt. Skull: a rounded chunky dome (low-segment sphere or loft) about 0.34 wide, indigo, with a cream muzzle wedge at the front and cream cheek fur tufts (small flat triangular tufts with ink outline strips) below the eyes. The face is the hero: two bold stylized eyes—ink almond shapes as seated parts (or decals) with a small cream highlight dot each, angled slightly, reading clearly from the front; cream brow strips above them; a large gold crescent-moon emblem seated flat on the brow centre (a crescent extrude, gold with a thin ink outline), the baku's signature mark. Ears on earL/earR: big rounded tapir ears (flattened domes or two-sided slabs) indigo outside, cream inside rim, with ink edge strips and a small plum inner patch. The upper jaw is a short blunt muzzle on the head bone; the lower jaw is a separate slab on the jaw joint so the mouth can open, cream-chinned, with a vermilion mouth interior and a small bone tusk at each jaw corner curving up. A short mane continues from the neck: 3-4 small ink and plum blade tufts on the head crest between the ears. Finish with a thin ink outline strip tracing the jaw line and cheek. Do not build the trunk: it starts at mount trunkBase and belongs to the trunk part—leave the muzzle front open there.
parts.attaches: Sits on the neck joint at mount neckBase, riding the head, jaw and ear joints; the muzzle front ends at mount trunkBase where the trunk part's base ring begins.

parts.builds: The baku's prehensile trunk: a tapered sweep along the trunk1 and trunk2 joints, starting at mount trunkBase [0, 1.6, 1.4] about 0.13 in radius, curving down and forward to a tip near [0, 1.28, 1.78] that flares open like a trumpet curl. Coat indigo with 5-6 cream ring-ridges: thin bands (stuck torus-like rings or narrow sweep bands) around the trunk at intervals, each with a hairline ink outline on its lower edge. The tip flares into a cream-lined opening: a rim ring in ink, the interior vermilion, with two small ink nostril dots. From the tip curl 3-4 glowing teal dream-smoke wisps: thin spiralled sweeps or small curl extrudes, teal and emissive (use the glow treatment on their parts), drifting up and back toward the brow—the smoke of dreams being inhaled. Two short cream whisker spines at the trunk base sides. Everything rides the trunk joints so the trunk can curl.
parts.attaches: Roots at mount trunkBase on the front of the head part's muzzle; the base ring must meet the muzzle front face cleanly. Smoke wisps drift up over the head box but only as thin curls, staying clear of the ears.

parts.builds: Four sturdy columnar tapir legs, one per limb mount. Each leg is a two-bone sweep from its mount (shoulderFL/FR at y = 1.15, hipHL/HR at y = 1.18) down through the knee and fetlock joints to the foot, slightly thicker at the thigh (radius about 0.15) tapering to 0.09 at the fetlock; hind legs show a hint of a backward hock angle. Upper leg indigo; from just below the knee down the legs turn cream (the tapir's pale stockings), the colour split a clean hard band with a thin ink outline ring at the boundary. Above each foot a gold anklet band with a small vermilion stud at its front. Each foot: a low rounded hoof block resting flat on y = 0, split into three bold toes (three small front-facing wedge pieces in bone colour with ink claws and ink separations), the underside in ink. Add a small plum knee patch on each foreleg. Feet must plant exactly on the floor; nothing hangs below y = 0.
parts.attaches: Each leg roots at one of the four limb mounts (shoulderFL, shoulderFR, hipHL, hipHR), meeting the body part's socket blushes there; the tops of the thighs sink slightly into the body's lower barrel so no gap shows.

parts.builds: The spirit's tail and the clouds it stands among. Tail: a short thick lion-like tail sweeping from mount tailBase [0, 1.25, -0.82] back and up through tail1 and tail2 to a curling tip near [0, 1.62, -1.3], indigo along its length with a bold tuft at the tip—5-6 flat blade tufts fanning out in plum and ink with gold tips—plus a gold ring band near the tuft root. Around the feet, ukiyo-e cloud swirls: 4-6 stylized flat spiral cloud masses (extruded outlines with thick rounded lobes, or stacked rounded slabs) in wave pale-blue with ink rim outline strips, pooled on the floor y = 0 around and between the legs, modest in size so the legs stay readable—no cloud higher than 0.35. Two or three small glowing teal dream-orbs (small spheres, emissive teal with a cream highlight dot) float just above the clouds near the front paws and one near the tail, the dreams the baku has eaten.
parts.attaches: Tail roots at mount tailBase meeting the body part's rear end; the clouds sit on the floor around the legs part's feet and must not swallow them—clouds keep clear of the leg cylinders by a finger's width.
